top_signal.title: Looking for 3-5 early-stage founders to start a weekly virtual mastermind
top_signal.summary: Hi everyone,  I’m looking to bring together a small, dedicated group of  3-5 early-stage founders  to form a weekly virtual mastermind.  Being a founder can be incredibly isolating, and having a tight-knit peer group to brainstorm with, stay accountable to, and share the highs and lows with makes a massive difference.    💡 About Me  I am 25 years old and I have always had a passion for business and owning what I do.  The Project:  Third Party Recruitment Firm/Interview help.  Current Stage:  Fully active- it is my 9-5 as of Mid October 2026. I am still in the beginning stage of things but I have spent months preparing so it is the start of the outbound portion of what I do.   My Background:  5 years in third party recruitment/outbound sales and research. Full 360 desk for those in the recruitment space.   My Goal:  To find peers who are similarly obsessed with growth, execution, and hitting milestones over the next 6–12 months. I have not found people who are in a similar situation as me where I live. Wanting to really dive into my business, I don't want it to feel like I or anyone else is entirely alone and lose the ability to bounce ideas, problems, or successes to someone.
